name: ln-pipeline
description: The ln-agents delivery pipeline. A deterministic orchestrator owns every transition; humans sign approvals outside A2A.

skills.name: start_run
skills.description: Create a run from an entry spec at START, then advance it.

skills.name: advance
skills.description: Advance a run until it needs a human, pauses, finishes or runs out of steps.

skills.name: status
skills.description: The run's state: where it is, its status, budget and pause reason.

skills.name: evidence
skills.description: What a human decides on at H1, R1 or R2: the evidence they sign, the choices, who may sign, and a readable Markdown report (written to the run's approvals/ folder).

skills.name: ask
skills.description: Ask the coordinator model a question about a run. It answers in text from the run's Markdown views and changes nothing.

skills.name: models
skills.description: The model catalog of the repository's registry: each model's provider, family, capabilities, what it is bound to and, when bound, its readiness and conformance. Read-only; it needs no run and calls no model.

skills.name: agents
skills.description: Which model each agent slot of the registry is bound to (and what runs on it), and the registry changes waiting for a human. Read-only; it needs no run.

skills.name: registry_change
skills.description: Draft one change to policy/model_registry.yaml: add a model (or claim capabilities for one the catalog has), remove an unbound model, or bind an agent slot to a model. Code checks it against every registry rule and stores it with a diff; nothing is written to policy/ until a human's apply_change.

skills.name: propose_mapping
skills.description: Ask the authority (the model LN-AGENTS.md names, if the registry binds it to human_authority) to propose which model serves which agent slot, optionally for a stated intent. Code checks every binding against the registry's rules and stores what survives as a draft with a diff, like registry_change; it writes nothing to policy/. Spends the model's subscription allowance.

skills.name: apply_change
skills.description: Write a stored draft to policy/model_registry.yaml, if the file is still the one the draft was made from and the result still passes every rule. Takes a draft's id and nothing else, so it cannot write anything a draft did not hold. The human's /confirm.

skills.name: discard_change
skills.description: Drop a stored draft without writing it. The human's /discard.

skills.name: approval_document
skills.description: Write the unsigned approval document and return the ssh-keygen and `run decide` commands. The human signs and decides; nothing here approves.
